hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' <<<"$input"); if grep -Eq 'rm -rf|git clean -[a-z]*f|git checkout -- |git config --global' <<<"$cmd"; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked by CLAUDE.md Destructive Operations rule: list exactly what will be deleted and get confirmation first."}}'; fi
input=$(cat); f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' <<<"$input"); case "$f" in */api/*.py) (cd api && uv run ruff check --fix "$f") 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
